scenarios.name: Local health and homepage
scenarios.result: Frontend and backend health returned HTTP 200; homepage rendered without fatal page error.

scenarios.name: Synthetic signup and email_outbox persistence
scenarios.result: Playwright signup returned HTTP 201 in about 7000 ms and navigated to /app. A read-only check found one WELCOME outbox record with PENDING status and zero attempts. No email worker ran.

scenarios.name: Successful login, logout and session invalidation
scenarios.result: UI login HTTP 200 in about 1415 ms; a further login returned HTTP 200 in 1629 ms; logout HTTP 204 in 10 ms; GET /api/auth/me after logout returned HTTP 401 in 10 ms.

scenarios.name: Mercado Pago seller test identity
scenarios.result: Authenticated GET /users/me returned HTTP 200; test_user tag and test nickname pattern observed. No raw account identifiers or credentials saved.

scenarios.name: Application checkout preference
scenarios.result: Authenticated browser fetch for PRE_DIAGNOSTIC_PLUS returned HTTP 400 in 5828 ms. Then Playwright selected Pré-Diagnóstico ESG Autodeclarável in /app/upgrade (R$ 250,00, quantity 1), clicked Comprar Agora and submitted PRE_DIAGNOSTIC; HTTP 400 in 5751 ms with auto_return invalid; back_url.success must be defined. Provider sandbox unit price logged as R$ 0.01. No preference/checkout URL; local order/diagnostic records rolled back and post-check counts were zero.

scenarios.name: Sandbox checkout opening and payment
scenarios.result: No sandbox checkout URL was created. The official Checkout Pro test buyer account was not confirmed, so no checkout page was opened and no card/payment was submitted.

scenarios.name: Official Mercado Pago test card research
scenarios.result: Reviewed current official Checkout Pro test card and holder-result table, including APRO, OTHE, CONT, SECU and EXPI. Card numbers were neither saved nor submitted.

scenarios.name: Success and failure return routes
scenarios.result: Without a preference or transaction, /app/checkout/success returned HTTP 200 and displayed payment approved; /app/checkout/failure returned HTTP 200 and displayed payment rejected. Success navigation also logged Maximum update depth exceeded at frontend/src/features/company-area/context/cart-context.tsx:45. No remote payment state changed.

scenarios.name: Email delivery
scenarios.result: WELCOME outbox status remained PENDING with zero attempts; no worker or email delivery was exercised.

scenarios.name: Webhook scenarios
scenarios.result: Not tested while another agent works on webhook files; QA did not edit those files.

scenarios.name: Production, migrations and load constraints
scenarios.result: No production calls, migrations, load tests, payment submissions or payment-changing webhook calls were made.

scenarios.name: UI signup validation
scenarios.result: Empty step blocks advance; invalid synthetic CPF shows a visible error and keeps advance disabled. No registration was submitted in this validation scenario.

scenarios.name: Keyboard focus in login modal
scenarios.result: With the modal open, the first Tab moved focus to an anchor outside the modal.

scenarios.name: Mobile layout and FAQ
scenarios.result: At 375 px viewport, document/body scroll width measured 360 px with no horizontal overflow; FAQ expanded and answer was visible.

bugs.title: Checkout Pro preference rejected with localhost return URLs
bugs.reproduction: Log in as the synthetic account and POST PRE_DIAGNOSTIC_PLUS to /api/checkout/preference. Backend builds local back_urls; Mercado Pago responds HTTP 400 auto_return invalid/back_url.success must be defined; pending database records are rolled back.
bugs.hypothesis: The provider requires public HTTPS/named-domain back_urls and rejects localhost, as stated in its official documentation.

bugs.title: Success route displays approved payment without validating a transaction
bugs.reproduction: With the synthetic test user authenticated and no checkout preference/payment, visit /app/checkout/success; UI displays Pagamento Confirmado and Aprovado.

bugs.title: Checkout success return triggers Maximum update depth exceeded
bugs.reproduction: Visit /app/checkout/success while authenticated. The Next.js dev runtime logs Maximum update depth exceeded and points to cart-context.tsx:45.
bugs.hypothesis: clearCart has unstable identity and sets a fresh empty array in an effect depending on clearCart, repeating the render/effect cycle.

bugs.title: First keyboard Tab escapes the login modal
bugs.reproduction: Open /?auth=true and press Tab once; focus moves to an anchor outside the modal.

blocked_items: No checkout preference/init_point was produced because Mercado Pago rejected localhost return URLs; an authorized HTTPS test domain or tunnel is needed.
No payment was submitted because the Checkout Pro buyer test account was not confirmed, even though the seller identity was confirmed as a test user.
Email delivery was not tested; the outbox item is pending and no worker was started.
Webhook scenarios were deferred while the parallel webhook agent is modifying those files.

synthetic_accounts.result: One synthetic test account created successfully; password and full identifiers not recorded.

improvements.item: Use an explicitly authorized HTTPS test return domain/tunnel for Checkout Pro; do not route test returns to production.
Validate server-side payment state before rendering payment success or granting any access.
Stabilize the cart clear callback/effect cycle on the success route.
Verify WELCOME email delivery only with a configured test worker/provider.
Keep keyboard focus inside the login modal and restore focus on close.

next_actions: After user authorization, correct BUG-R5-002/003 and rerun local return routes.

Once an HTTPS test return URL and confirmed test buyer account are available, retry the preference, open only its sandbox URL, and complete an official test-card scenario if all test identity checks pass.
After the parallel webhook implementation is complete, retest only against localhost with signature fixtures.
Do not apply migrations or perform additional fixes without user approval.
Review the login modal focus behavior after user authorization for corrections.
